name: mehfooz-status-control
description: Mehfooz Status Control — by Mehfooz Ahmad (Saif Chishti / Chishti Brothers). Real-time WhatsApp Group Status broadcast & group-management dashboard: post groupStatusMessageV2 to one or many groups at once with a live SSE progress monitor, search/select across 1,500+ groups, leave-group management, and operation history. Built on the @itsliaaa/baileys fork of Baileys.
